summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # ** Petition No. 649/TT/2020 ** # **Coram:** ** Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member ** # **Date of Order: 11.09.2024** # **In the matter of:** Corrigendum to the order dated 2.8.2024 in Petition No. 649/TT/2020. # **And** # **In the matter of:** Approval under Regulation 86 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999 for determination of transmission tariff for 2019-24 tariff period under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for **Asset I-** 1X1500 MVA 765/400 kV ICT-II along with associated bays and 2 Nos. 400 kV Line Bays for termination of 400 kV D/C Prithala-Aligarh TBCB Line at Aligarh 765 kV Switching Sub-station and **Asset II-** 1X1500 MVA 765/400 kV ICT-I at Aligarh 765 kV Switching Sub-station under “ICTs and Bays Associated with Northern Region System Strengthening Scheme (NRSSXXXVIII)”. # **And** # **In the matter of:** Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, “Saudamini”, Plot No. 2, Sector 29, Gurgaon-122001 (Haryana). ** . Petitioner** - **Vs.** 1. Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Prasaran Nigam Limited, Vidyut Bhawan, Vidyut Marg, Jaipur-302005 (Rajasthan) and 18 others. ** Respondent(s)** Corrigendum order in Petition No. 649/TT/2020 Page 1 of 2 # ** CORRIGENDUM ORDER ** In terms of Regulation 54, read with Regulation 66 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023, the order dated 2.8.2024 in Petition No. 649/TT/2020 has been amended as under: (a) In the last sentence of paragraph 48, before the word ‘days’, wherever it occurred, figure ‘56’ shall be added. (b) In column 5 of the table under paragraph 51, before the word ‘days’ the figures ‘56’ shall be added. (c) In paragraph 96, lines 2 and 6, the figures ‘2019” shall be read as figure “2020”. 2. All other terms of the order dated 2.8.2024 in Petition No. 649/TT/2020 shall remain unaltered. Sd/sd/- **(Jishnu Barua) (Ramesh Babu V.) Chairperson Member** CERC Website S.
